exact_statement: Let f be a Boolean function on n bits, N > n, x0 in {-1,1}^N, p = 2^(-N), and g_N(x) = f(x_1..x_n)(1 - 2*1{x = x0}). (a) ghat_N(S) = fhat(S)*1{S subset [n]} - 2p f(x0) chi_S(x0) for every S subset [N]; for every A subset [N] the coefficient of g_N*chi_A at [N] is nonzero, so d_{g_N chi_A}(S) = N for every S and every anchor A, and U(g_N) = N Var(g_N) - I(g_N). (b) |I_i(g_N) - I_i(f)| <= 2p for every i, so |I(g_N) - I(f)| <= 2Np. (c) the spectral laws satisfy ||p(g_N) - p(f)||_1 <= 4p(2^(n/2) + 1), and |H(g_N) - H(f)| <= eps N + h2(eps) with eps = 2p(2^(n/2) + 1). (d) for nonconstant f, H(g_N) -> H(f), I(g_N) -> I(f) and U(g_N)/I(g_N) -> infinity. (e) if psi(s,N) >= 0 with max_s psi(s,N) = o(2^N) and Psi(g) = sum over nonempty S with ghat(S) != 0 of ghat(S)^2 psi(|S|, d_g(S)), then Psi(g_N) - sum_{S nonempty} fhat(S)^2 psi(|S|, N) -> 0; hence an inequality H <= alpha I + beta Var + Psi valid for all Boolean functions implies H(f) <= alpha I(f) + beta Var(f) + liminf_N sum_{S nonempty} fhat(S)^2 psi(|S|, N) for all Boolean f. (f) FEI with constant C on the class {g_N} implies FEI with constant C for all Boolean functions.
hypotheses: uniform measure on the Boolean cube; Boolean outputs in {-1,1}
entropy in bits; p_S = fhat(S)^2; I = sum |S| p_S; Var = 1 - p_empty
d_g(S) = max{|T| : T contains S, ghat(T) != 0}; U(g) = sum over nonempty S with p_S > 0 of p_S (d_g(S) - |S|)
N > n; f fixed while N -> infinity in (c)-(f)

exact_statement: For every Boolean sign f on n>=0 uniform bits, every integer N>n with N>=2 and every input x0, put delta=2^-N and g_N=f(x_1,...,x_n)(1-2*1{x=x0}). Then ghat_N(S)=fhat(S)1{S subset [n]}-2delta f(x0)chi_S(x0); every coefficient is nonzero, so every character anchor has top coefficient nonzero and d=N on all sets. U(g_N)=N Var(g_N)-I(g_N), each physical coordinate influence changes by at most 2delta, and ||p(g_N)-p(f)||_1<=4delta(2^(n/2)+1). Put eta=min(2delta(2^(n/2)+1),1-2^-N). Then |H(g_N)-H(f)|<=h2(eta)+eta log2(2^N-1). For every fixed nonconstant seed, H and I converge to seed values and U/I diverges. For any nonnegative support weight psi with max_s psi(s,N)=o(2^N), its edited expectation on nonempty atoms minus sum_nonempty fhat(S)^2 psi(|S|,N) tends to zero. FEI with a fixed constant on this corrected padded-edited class implies FEI with the same constant on every Boolean seed; constants are handled separately.

exact_statement: For a-bit addressing A_a, a>=1, padded to N>=a+2^a, the fixed binary selector/data/padding hierarchy all-subset prefix code has Gamma_T(A_a)=3+2a+2R(a)+2*1{N>a+2^a}, where R(1)=0 and R(k)=1-2^{-k}+R(floor(k/2))+R(ceil(k/2)), and Gamma_T(A_a)<=8I(A_a)-5. Every Boolean truth-table edit f of density rho obeys H(f)<=Gamma_T(f)<=16I(f)-10+48N*rho-8rho. Thus N*rho<=1/8 gives <=16I(f), and every one-point edit gives <=25I(f), with <=16I(f) for N>=6. For any Boolean g on a split cube Z union Y with r=|Z|>=1 and |Y|>=1, join fixed binary singleton-leaf trees on Z,Y, put W_Z,W_Y for their internal-mask costs, and flip g on z=z*. Writing rho=2^{-r}, h=g(z*,.), m_h=Eh and U_Z=sum_v 2(1-2^{-|C_v|}), the exact difference-spectrum cost is E_delta=4rho[1+2(1-rho*m_h^2)+U_Z+E_{S_h}W_Y]. Partial restriction Parseval gives rho*E_{S_h}W_Y<=E_{S_g}W_Y, hence E_delta<=4E_{S_g}W_Y+4rho(2r+1) and Gamma_T(f)<=2Gamma_T(g)+8E_{S_g}W_Y+8rho(2r+1). Free-coordinate influences are unchanged, and I_Z(f)+I_Z(g)>=2r*rho.

exact_statement: For any fixed singleton-leaf partition tree with internal cells C_v and child arities b_v, put L(S)=1+sum_v b_v*1{S meets C_v} and <u,v>_L=sum_S uhat(S)vhat(S)L(S). For arbitrary real u,v, <u,v>_L=(1+sum_v b_v)E[uv]-sum_v b_v E[(E[u|C_v^c])(E[v|C_v^c])]. For distinct one-point Boolean edits e_x=-2g(x)1{X=x}, e_y=-2g(y)1{X=y}, the cross is -4g(x)g(y)2^(-2N)sum_v b_v*2^(N-|C_v|)*1{x,y agree outside C_v}. It can be positive despite disjoint physical edit supports: the two-bit x1 seed with edits (+,+),(-,+) gives cross=1/2, individual energies 5/2 and combined energy 6. Moreover for any Boolean core h on a nonempty Y, let g=x1*h(Y), Z={x1,x2}, and join the binary Z tree and any binary Y tree under a binary root. Disjoint proper subcube edits D1={x1=+,x2=+},D2={x1=-,x2=+} have cross=(1+(Eh)^2)/2>=1/2. Their final sign is f=-x1*x2*h, with Gamma(f)=Gamma(g)=5+E_(S_h)W_Y, H(f)=H(g)=H(h), and I(f)=I(g)+1. Thus no finite physical-intersection-density-only bound controls the signed or absolute edit cross; the exact source/edit rebate and retained-core cost cannot be discarded.
